newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL shares seen steady, more action on second board.
newsitem.headline: KL shares seen steady, more action on second board.

text.p: Major stocks will largely remain steady, with avid buying seen continuing on second board stocks, dealers said.
The market continued to lack fresh fundamental leads, but speculation on contracts and restructurings will again drive secondary stocks, they said.
"It's the same old story. Buy the second board and wait for news for the blue chips," said an institutional dealer.
But another dealer said the market's upside will be limited as players may want to pocket some profits for the weekend.
